svg.aria-label: A flame graph of a Go benchmark's CPU profile, drawn with the root at the bottom: testing.(*B).run1.func1, runN, BenchmarkCount, tally.Count, then tally.Parse with strings.Fields, time.Parse, time.ParseDuration and strconv.Atoi above it, and bufio.(*Scanner).Text and two map assignments beside Parse. Smaller towers on the right are runtime work.
